title: How to Swap BTC to SOL - Convert Bitcoin to Solana without KYC
description:
Need to swap BTC to SOL but don't want to mess up the transaction? In this beginner tutorial, I walk you through exactly how to convert bitcoin to solana using the instant exchange without any KYC.

If you are tired of slow Bitcoin network fees and want to join the Solana ecosystem, this guide is for you.

swap btc to sol,convert bitcoin to solana,btc to solana,bitcoin to solana,btc to sol swap,btc to sol bridge

asr.full_text: In this video, I am going to show you how to swap your bitcoin to Solana in a few minutes. To start, visit ShapeChing. Next, enter the amount of how much BTC you want to swap. Select Solana in drop-down menu, and click exchange now. Fill in your Solana destination wallet. Additionally, you can fill in Your BTC wallet address in case the exchange fails. Make sure you agree with terms of services and click next step. Double check everything is correct. If so, click Confirm Details. Now send funds to the generated address. Your transaction will be processed automatically.
